purpose: Resolve the zero-qualified-positive-donor admission failure (G4 protocol V0) by (a) fixing the accept-cell neutral with the schema-native same-author duplicate vote, (b) searching for appended-conflict scenes the C head DOES recognize, (c) qualifying positive donors for a separately-frozen bidirectional patching stage.

baseline_eligibility: twins_streamlet DEV; scene-level non-reuse: exclude by state hash the 26 G3 pair scenes and the 12 A428 scenes
group reuse is disclosed (all 42 DEV groups previously touched by some round; the unseen-group criterion is exhausted - recorded validity boundary)
wait cell: C=0, support=quorum-1, fresh validator exists (treatment voter), observed alternative block exists
accept cell: C=0, support>=quorum, observed alternative block exists
received nondecreasing; max(received) <= decision_time; seconds/received values pairwise distinct
stage_1_cpu_construction.treatment_edit: append valid vote for a different observed block by the lowest-index supporter (deterministic); received = max(existing); block chosen by preregistered token-width scan: lowest observed non-candidate block whose token length equals candidate_block (CPU tokenizer scan at construction; fallback lowest block + recorded mismatch)
stage_1_cpu_construction.sa_neutral_edit: append a duplicate of an existing candidate vote (same author as an existing candidate supporter - lowest-index supporter -, same candidate block, same round, received = max(existing)); gold provably invariant in BOTH cells; author-valid and in-contract by construction; token match vs treatment verified and recorded (expected by block-width symmetry of the treatment scan)

stage_2_gpu_donor_search.reads: conflicting_vote head (primary), certificate_action and quorum heads (secondary), evidence_level (integer-parsed)

donor_qualification.QUALIFIED_POSITIVE_DONOR: old C=false AND new C=true AND SA C=false (neutral gold-invariance respected by the model)
donor_qualification.PARTIAL: new C=true with old C=false-alarm (reported separately)

stage_2_gpu_donor_search.outputs: donor roster with per-arm conflict-head margins and logits; search is explicitly exploratory (Zhang & Nanda clean-run selection practice)

stage_3_patching_separately_frozen.design_preview: bidirectional candidate-end key patching at branch-relative C-branch anchors between qualified-donor and failing scenes, both directions, with SA-sham same-location, random-token, and off-target-head (quorum/action) controls; budget frozen only after the donor roster is known and the G0E blind review has ruled
stage_3_patching_separately_frozen.gate: requires >=1 QUALIFIED_POSITIVE_DONOR; zero donors => demote per the G-1 falsifier

oracles: same C/Q truth table as A461-G3 (dual independent implementations required)
stop_conditions: STOP_INSUFFICIENT_PAIRS: fewer than 10 eligible pairs in a cell after scene-level exclusions (freeze what exists)
STOP_ZERO_DONORS: reserved for stage-2 interpretation (demotion path, not a run failure)

hard_resource_bounds.construction: CPU; 1 tokenizer/checkpoint-free phase (token-width scan uses tokenizer.json via CPU encode of short label strings only; no model weights)

execution.authorization: user standing authorization series 2026-10-25; stage-2 budget frozen here before execution

interpretation_boundaries: donor search is exploratory; patching claims require the separately frozen stage; no deployment/attacker claims; source-local policy labels only
